text:
mira (Design): Quick pass on the new Activity cards in the dashboard: focus ring in light theme is almost invisible and keyboarding into card menus sometimes skips to the next region. Can we triage?
ash (Frontend): Thanks — suspect two things: focus outline is 1px and same color as card border, and our menu unmounts during close animation which could drop tab focus.
mira (Design): Screenshot attached. Expected: clear focus indicator distinct from selected state, and predictable focus order after opening/closing menus.
jordan (A11y): A11y notes: 1) Make focus visually distinct (recommend 3px outline or high-contrast box-shadow). 2) For menus, use `aria-expanded` on the trigger and keep menu in DOM until animation completes; optionally use a focus trap while open. 3) Check for duplicate SR announcements when toggling menu — might be coming from an `aria-live` region.
lee (QA): Repro on Mac/Chrome with VoiceOver: Tab to card action, press Space to open, Tab -> focus jumps to page header. Also VoiceOver sometimes reads the card title twice on open.
ash (Frontend): Quick CSS patch we can try:
```
.card-action:focus {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.menu[aria-hidden='false'] { visibility: visible; }
```
And change JS to add `data-closing` class and only remove menu after transitionend. Will prototype and post screenshots.
mira (Design): Neutral outline sounds good for now. We can explore using brand accent for active state later. Also prefer `prefers-reduced-motion` handling for the menu.
jordan (A11y): Also add `prefers-contrast: more` support to increase outline thickness for users who need it. Add unit tests to ensure focusable elements remain in DOM while transitions run.
lee (QA): I'll add an e2e Cypress test to tab into each card, open menu, assert focus stays inside menu and that Shift+Tab returns to trigger. Will include VoiceOver smoke test in staging.
ash (Frontend): I'll open PR 1592 with the CSS + JS change and tests, tag @mira and @jordan for review.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging 20:00 UTC
mira (Design): Decision for patch: 1) 3px neutral outline in light theme, 2) keep menus mounted during animation, 3) add reduced-motion and high-contrast tweaks. Non-blocking: revisit accent usage next sprint.
jordan (A11y): Thanks. Please add a short line in release notes about the keyboard/focus fixes so folks know.
lee (QA): Marking P2; will run smoke tests after PR lands.
